Prices are reported listings, not independently verified live checkout totals.</text>

## Important RV consideration

A 30-amp RV outlet does **not** mean the power station can deliver 30 amps continuously. A 2,400W inverter supplies approximately 20 amps at 120V.

That is generally sufficient for lights, a refrigerator, a water pump, and smaller appliances, but not for running all major RV appliances simultaneously. A rooftop air conditioner may also exceed its starting or continuous power limits.

**Bottom line:** Choose the BLUETTI AC200L for its RV-oriented features and solar capability. Choose the Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO if price-to-capacity value is your priority. Both are credible choices under $900 based on the provided results.
